records.title: Chevron Richmond Refinery Fire
records.publisher: U.S. Chemical Safety and Hazard Investigation Board (CSB)
verified_facts: CSB identifies a catastrophic pipe failure and flammable vapor release.
The report discusses corrosion, inspection limitations, and recommendations for inspection and material verification.
records.candidate_use: Manufacturing consequence analogy for degraded equipment evidence and inspection/maintenance decisions.
records.agent_link_limit: The incident does not involve an AI Agent or a production scheduler. Do not claim an Agent caused it.
records.rights_note: Link and self-written summary only; confirm source terms before storing full text.

records.title: ExxonMobil Refinery Explosion (Torrance)
records.publisher: U.S. Chemical Safety and Hazard Investigation Board (CSB)
verified_facts: CSB describes a pressure deviation during maintenance isolation preparations while the unit was idled.
The CSB summary cites weaknesses in safe operating limits, safeguard verification, and reuse of a procedure deviation without sufficient hazard analysis.
records.candidate_use: Manufacturing consequence analogy for changed operating conditions and maintenance/readiness state that must be rechecked before a work decision.
records.agent_link_limit: Not evidence of an AI scheduling failure. Use only if the target Agent receives and can act on equipment readiness or isolation state.
records.rights_note: CSB investigation summary page; link and self-written summary only.

records.title: Carbide Industries Fire and Explosion
records.publisher: U.S. Chemical Safety and Hazard Investigation Board (CSB)
verified_facts: CSB describes continued furnace operation despite recurring cooling-water leaks and prior warning events.
The CSB summary explains how water leaks could disrupt material flow and create a hazardous reaction pathway in that specific process.
records.candidate_use: Manufacturing consequence analogy for continuing work with known equipment condition and repeated warnings.
records.agent_link_limit: Process-specific chemistry cannot be transferred to the project's generic production scheduler. Only use if a compatible equipment-state and stop-work decision are explicitly modeled.
records.rights_note: CSB investigation summary page; link and self-written summary only.

records.title: Security challenges in AI agent deployment: Insights from a large scale public competition
verified_facts: The study reports a public red-team competition against 22 frontier agents across 44 scenarios.
It reports 1.8 million submitted prompt-injection attacks and over 60,000 policy violations, and introduces the ART benchmark.
records.candidate_use: Agentic research evidence for testing whether untrusted input can lead to policy-violating tool behavior.
records.agent_link_limit: Primarily adversarial prompt-injection and security behavior. It is not evidence of manufacturing harm or production scheduling errors; only applicable if the target has an untrusted-content input path.
records.rights_note: Research summary page links the full paper; cite the paper version and verify exact methods before RAG adoption.

records.title: Security Risks in Tool-Enabled AI Agents: A Systematic Analysis of Privileged Execution Environments
verified_facts: The paper presents a risk taxonomy and three representative agent scenarios.
It reports a small controlled experiment and discusses over-privileged tools, capability-intent mismatch, and ambient authority leakage.
records.candidate_use: Agentic failure mechanism evidence for least privilege, tool-scope, and declared-capability checks.
records.agent_link_limit: Cloud execution environment focus. Use only where the target's declared tools or runtime privileges match the paper's mechanism; not a manufacturing incident source.
records.rights_note: Microsoft Research page links arXiv; verify version and paper sections before RAG adoption.

records.title: AgentHarm: A Benchmark for Measuring Harmfulness of LLM Agents
verified_facts: The benchmark defines agent tasks across harmful behavior categories and evaluates agent actions, not just text responses.
records.candidate_use: Background for action-level harmfulness evaluation and separating refusal from tool execution.
records.agent_link_limit: Broad harmful-intent benchmark; weak direct mapping to routine manufacturing business constraints. Not a substitute for target-specific tool and policy tests.
records.rights_note: Research summary; inspect primary benchmark and license before any data ingestion.
